title: Opinionated Compatibility Pack - Recipes
description: This project aims to add some balanced cross-mod recipes to improve the gameplay experience.
body:
The goal of this recipe datapack is to improve sideways progression, without significantly impacting balance.

I usually play with a few different mods, and having to keep track of a growing number of recipes is somewhat painful.

For this reason I have made this datapack, to consolidate multiple recipes from multiple mods.

Each recipe will only load if the neoforge or fabric load conditions are met.

Any contributions or suggestions made to the github are appreciated.

List of (optional) mods with additions here:

- Create
- Farmer's Delight
- Fishcasting
- Hex Casting

Open a PR if you want to contribute, or open an issue if you have a suggestion.
